item.title: How a TD Bank teller laundered millions for $50 bribes
item.description: Court documents reveal how a teller used the drive-through window and work email to aid a scheme that bypassed TD's fraud defenses.

item.title: Chicago bank becomes first failure of 2026
item.description: The Chicago-based, $261 million-asset Metropolitan Capital Bank & Trust was placed in receivership and its assets sold to Detroit-based First Independence Bank, costing the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp.'s Deposit Insurance Fund an estimated $19.7 million.

item.title: UBS faces high-stakes Senate hearing over Nazi accounts
item.description: When the Swiss banking giant bought rival Credit Suisse in 2023, it inherited an investigation over money the Nazis looted from European Jews. The issue now seems to be coming to a head in Washington.

item.title: Fifth Third closes Comerica acquisition in under four months
item.description: The combination of the banks is the latest in a trend of deals closing on speedier timelines, and signals the industry's hunt for scale.

item.title: Simmons Bank hires new leaders to boost organic growth
item.description: The Arkansas-based company pivoted to organic growth a few years ago, after making 14 bank acquisitions in less than a decade.

item.title: Atomic settlement swaps one risk for another, and banks aren't ready
item.description: As tokenization increasingly brings instant settlement to transactions, the liquidity buffer that batch settlement has provided for decades is going to shrink and then disappear. Banks will need to rethink liquidity management.

item.title: Banks' battle against stablecoin yield is already a lost cause
item.description: Instead of fighting to keep the banking industry unchanged, perhaps it's time for banks to accept that change is inevitable and focus on adapting to remain competitive.

item.title: Illinois bank taps a partner to help launch trust business
item.description: In keeping with its policy of outsourcing functions outside its core commercial and retail banking competency, Signature Bank near Chicago teamed with a larger trust company to fill a longstanding gap in its product set.

item.title: Where BVNK, Polygon Labs think stablecoin payments will happen
item.description: While stablecoins aren't widely used for merchant payments, blockchain tech firms such as BVNK and Polygon Labs are seeking opportunities to add speed to slow-moving international transfers.

item.title: Varo raises $124 million despite widening net losses
item.description: The digital bank added two new board members and raised $123.9 million as it continues to manage regulatory costs amid its push for profitability.
